keybind.toggleHint: GM only. Freezes player token movement and shows the narrative banner.

notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can toggle Narrative Mode.

settings.borderEnabledHint: When on, a pulsing border glow is shown while Narrative Mode is active.
settings.tintColorHint: Color of the pulsing border glow shown while Narrative Mode is active. Default red.
settings.bannerTextHint: Text of the banner shown at the top-center while Narrative Mode is on.
settings.blockMessageHint: Message a player sees when they try to move a token during Narrative Mode.
settings.toastDurationHint: How long the blocked-move message stays on screen before it fades.
settings.showBannerToPlayersHint: When on, players also see the top-center Narrative Mode banner.
settings.tintAllClientsHint: When on, the border flash shows for everyone. When off, only the GM sees it.
settings.alsoPauseGameHint: When on, toggling Narrative Mode also toggles Foundry's built-in pause.
settings.debugLevelHint: Console logging verbosity for this module.
